messages.description: Branch delete dialog: prompt for deleting one remote branch
Branch delete: notice after one remote branch was deleted
Branch delete dialog: title when several branches are deleted at once (count is at least 2)
Branch delete dialog: what deleting the listed local branches does
Branch delete dialog: what deleting the listed remote branches does
Branch delete dialog: how many marked references are left out
Branch delete: notice after several branches were all deleted (count is at least 2)
Branch delete: notice when some of several branches could not be deleted, with the first failure
Branch menu: delete every branch marked in the log's branches pane

en-US.desktop.branch.deleteRemotePrompt: Delete the remote branch '{name}'? It is deleted from the remote for everyone who uses it, and its remote-tracking branch is removed here.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteManyLocal: Local branches are deleted even if they are not merged; commits only on them will no longer be on any branch.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteManyRemote: Remote branches are deleted from their remote for everyone who uses it.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteSkipped: Left out of the selection: {count}. Tags, HEAD and the current branch are not deleted here.

zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteRemotePrompt: 删除远程分支“{name}”？它会从远程仓库中删除，所有使用这个仓库的人都将看不到它，本地对应的远程跟踪分支也会一并移除。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyLocal: 本地分支即使尚未合并也会删除，只在这些分支上的提交将不再属于任何分支。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyRemote: 远程分支会从远程仓库中删除，所有使用这个仓库的人都将看不到它们。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteSkipped: 所选项中有 {count} 项不会删除：标签、HEAD 和当前分支不在这里删除。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyFailed: {total} 个分支中有 {failed} 个删除失败。{name}：{reason}
